mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential tightening by the Federal Reserve, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased costs for businesses, negatively affecting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a potential for monetary policy to shift towards easing, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals strong labor market conditions, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) both show a month-over-month increase, it signals a strengthening economy, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 0% and GDPC1 MoM > 0%.
